ja: • 連合宇宙艦隊の巡洋艦２隻、駆逐艦２隻のカラーパターンセットが登場。
• 巡洋艦８種類、駆逐艦12種類の登録No.船体名のデカールが付属。同型艦をそれぞれ再現できる。
• 同スケールのコスモゼロが付属。
en: • A color pattern set of two cruisers and two destroyers of the United Starfleet is now available.
• Decals with registration numbers and hull names for 8 types of cruisers and 12 types of destroyers are included. Each ship of the same type can be reproduced.
• Cosmo Zero of the same scale is included.
